title: 第1843章 天机阁前问前路混洞初显噬星辰第1842章 混洞初开万象吞玄帝一步踏苍穹
content_zh:
林玄踏入灰色漩涡的那一刻，感觉周围的时空在扭曲。
混洞境的力量，让他可以直接撕裂空间，进行远距离传送。
这种传送，不是普通的瞬移，而是直接吞噬掉两地之间的空间距离，将一方时空吞没，然后从另一方时空走出。
片刻后，他从灰色漩涡中走出，站在一片陌生的星域中。
前方，悬浮着一座巨大的星辰。
那颗星辰，通体呈银色，散发着柔和的光芒。
星辰上矗立着一座巍峨的高塔，塔身直插云霄，塔身上刻满了密密麻麻的符文，在不断闪烁。
那座高塔，就是天机阁。
林玄站在星空中，看着那座高塔，目光平静。
他能感觉到，那座高塔中，隐藏着无数强大的气息。
那些气息，最弱的也是鸿蒙境中期，最强的，甚至达到了鸿蒙境巅峰。
他沉默了片刻，然后迈步，朝那颗星辰飞去。
他刚靠近那颗星辰，一道银色的光芒，从高塔中射出，落在他面前，化作一道银色的光桥。
光桥上，站着一名身穿银色长袍的老者。
那老者头发花白，面容清癯，一双眼睛如同两颗深邃的星辰，仿佛能看穿一切。
他看着林玄，缓缓开口：“林玄道友，阁主已经等你很久了。”
林玄看着他，目光平静：“你知道朕要来？”
银袍老者微微一笑：“天机阁，上知天文，下知地理，中知人事。道友踏入混沌大世界的那一刻，阁主就已经算到，道友会来。”
林玄闻言，目光平静：“带路。”
银袍老者点了点头，转身，踏上银色光桥。林玄迈步，跟在他身后。

两人沿着银色光桥，朝高塔走去。
光桥两侧，是无尽的星空，星空中有无数星辰在闪烁。
那些星辰，按照某种玄妙的轨迹运行，形成一幅幅复杂的星图。
林玄看着那些星图，目光中闪过一丝明悟。
他能感觉到，那些星图蕴含了某种天地至理，如果仔细参悟，或许能领悟出一些东西。
但他没有停下来参悟。
他知道，现在不是时候。
片刻后，两人走到高塔前。
高塔的大门敞开着，大门内，是一条幽深的通道。
通道两侧，镶嵌着无数颗银色的宝石，散发着柔和的光芒。
银袍老者带着林玄，踏入通道。
两人沿着通道，走了大约一刻钟，来到一座巨大的大殿中。
大殿中央，盘坐着一名中年男子。
content_en:
The moment Lin Xuan stepped into the gray vortex, he felt that the time and space around him was distorting.
The power of the mixed cave realm allows him to directly tear apart space and teleport over long distances.
This kind of teleportation is not an ordinary teleportation, but directly swallows up the space distance between two places, engulfs one side of time and space, and then walks out of the other side of time and space.
After a moment, he walked out of the gray vortex and stood in an unfamiliar star field.
Ahead, there is a huge star suspended.
The star was silver in color and emitted a soft light.
There is a majestic tower standing on the stars. The tower reaches straight into the sky. The tower is engraved with dense runes that are constantly flashing.
That tall tower is Tianji Pavilion.
Lin Xuan stood in the starry sky, looking at the tall tower with calm eyes.
He could feel that there were countless powerful auras hidden in that tall tower.
Among those auras, the weakest ones are in the middle stage of Hongmeng Realm, and the strongest ones even reach the peak of Hongmeng Realm.
He was silent for a moment, then took steps and flew towards the star.
As soon as he approached the star, a silver light shot out from the tower, fell in front of him, and turned into a silver light bridge.
On the light bridge, stood an old man wearing a silver robe.
The old man had gray hair, a pale face, and a pair of eyes like two deep stars, as if he could see through everything.
He looked at Lin Xuan and spoke slowly: "Fellow Taoist Lin Xuan, the Pavilion Master has been waiting for you for a long time."
Lin Xuan looked at him with calm eyes: "You know I'm coming?"
The silver-robed old man smiled slightly: "Tianji Pavilion, the top knows astronomy, the bottom knows geography, and the middle knows human affairs. The moment fellow Taoist steps into the world of chaos, the master of the pavilion has already calculated that fellow Taoist will come."
When Lin Xuan heard this, his eyes were calm: "Lead the way."
The silver-robed old man nodded, turned around, and stepped onto the silver light bridge. Lin Xuan took steps and followed him.
The two walked along the silver light bridge towards the tower.
On both sides of the light bridge, there is an endless starry sky, with countless stars twinkling in the starry sky.
Those stars move according to some mysterious trajectories, forming complex star maps.
Lin Xuan looked at those star maps, a hint of understanding flashed in his eyes.
He could feel that those star maps contained some kind of truth of heaven and earth. If he studied them carefully, he might be able to understand something.
But he didn't stop to understand.
He knew that now was not the time.
After a while, the two walked to the tower.
The gate of the tower is open, and inside the gate is a deep passage.
On both sides of the passage, there are countless silver gems inlaid, emitting a soft light.
The silver-robed old man led Lin Xuan into the passage.
The two walked along the passage for about a quarter of an hour and arrived at a huge hall.
In the center of the hall, a middle-aged man sat cross-legged.
